note: City of Liberal park ~10 mi NE of Liberal on Hwy 54 near the Cimarron River, with fishing ponds (catch-and-release only: the ponds hold wastewater effluent), nature trails, a covered event pavilion and storm shelters. Concrete-pad sites; the park is gated at night (hours 7 am-10 pm). --Claude
